import zipfile, shutil, os, re

src = "/home/user/MaturityDate.xlsx"
backup = "/tmp/MaturityDate.bak.xlsx"
shutil.copy(src, backup)

# Read existing parts
extract_dir = "/tmp/xlsx_work"
if os.path.exists(extract_dir):
    shutil.rmtree(extract_dir)
os.makedirs(extract_dir)

with zipfile.ZipFile(src, 'r') as z:
    z.extractall(extract_dir)

# Update sharedStrings.xml — add "Maturity Date" as index 2
ss_path = os.path.join(extract_dir, "xl", "sharedStrings.xml")
with open(ss_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    ss = f.read()
ss = ss.replace('count="2" uniqueCount="2"', 'count="3" uniqueCount="3"')
ss = ss.replace('</sst>', '<si><t>Maturity Date</t></si></sst>')
with open(ss_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write(ss)

# Update sheet1.xml — add column C
sheet_path = os.path.join(extract_dir, "xl", "worksheets", "sheet1.xml")
with open(sheet_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    sheet = f.read()

# Compute maturity dates from existing rows
data = [
    (40437, 120),
    (40521, 90),
    (40548, 90),
    (40431, 100),
    (40534, 90),
    (40468, 120),
    (40555, 120),
    (40439, 180),
    (40426, 80),
]
maturities = [d + l for d, l in data]
print("Maturity serials:", maturities)

# Update dimension
sheet = sheet.replace('<dimension ref="A1:B10"/>', '<dimension ref="A1:C10"/>')

# Update cols to include column 3 with reasonable width
sheet = sheet.replace(
    '<col min="2" max="2" width="21.6640625" customWidth="1"/></cols>',
    '<col min="2" max="2" width="21.6640625" customWidth="1"/><col min="3" max="3" width="15" customWidth="1"/></cols>'
)

# Add C1 (header, shared string idx 2) and update spans
sheet = sheet.replace(
    '<row r="1" spans="1:2" x14ac:dyDescent="0.25"><c r="A1" t="s"><v>0</v></c><c r="B1" t="s"><v>1</v></c></row>',
    '<row r="1" spans="1:3" x14ac:dyDescent="0.25"><c r="A1" t="s"><v>0</v></c><c r="B1" t="s"><v>1</v></c><c r="C1" t="s"><v>2</v></c></row>'
)

# Add C2-C10 with date values, style=1 (the date format)
for i, m in enumerate(maturities, start=2):
    row_pattern = f'<row r="{i}" spans="1:2" x14ac:dyDescent="0.25"><c r="A{i}" s="1"><v>{data[i-2][0]}</v></c><c r="B{i}"><v>{data[i-2][1]}</v></c></row>'
    new_row = f'<row r="{i}" spans="1:3" x14ac:dyDescent="0.25"><c r="A{i}" s="1"><v>{data[i-2][0]}</v></c><c r="B{i}"><v>{data[i-2][1]}</v></c><c r="C{i}" s="1"><v>{m}</v></c></row>'
    if row_pattern not in sheet:
        print(f"WARN: pattern not found for row {i}")
    sheet = sheet.replace(row_pattern, new_row)

with open(sheet_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write(sheet)

# Repack zip
out_path = src
with zipfile.ZipFile(out_path, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(extract_dir):
        for fn in files:
            full = os.path.join(root, fn)
            rel = os.path.relpath(full, extract_dir)
            z.write(full, rel)

print("Done. Wrote", out_path)
